snippet.title: Hyper Tanks - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
▸Wishlist Hyper Tanks on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2615150/Hyper_Tanks/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=main_trailer_2026

Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in action-packed multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

Trailer Music: "Music To Wear Fingerless Gloves To" by Punch Deck, CC BY 3.0.
